duplicateNativeDescriptorScope: Both CC files already existed in8.3 and both declare native neoforge.mods.toml. Exact NeoForge discovery/version selection and runtime-loaded choice are not established by this static audit.

projectPages.html403Meaning: Inconclusive availability, not removed project. Existing mappings remain unchanged; none marked unavailable.
projectPages.sha256Scope: Prepared JAR SHA256 independently matched exact local official-download pin; live metadata confirms project/file/name/uploader/length, not an upstream SHA256 field.

safety.reason: The custom Modified-only terrain/NEW-mod policy is not global. ATM10 delivers exact author JARs, no own Safety JAR/profile/launcher recipe; current launcher source has no global terrain policy. Adding one would change the authorized stock composition.

checkedGates: Architectury block break/place, interactions, fill-bucket, explosions and NeoForge entity/mob/fluid events are registered.
ClaimedChunkManagerImpl.shouldPreventInteraction requires a ServerPlayer actor and honors bypass/config/team policy; nonplayer/null is not a universal denied-world-write interception.

Native defaults: disable_protection=false; fake player policy CHECK; default fake players false; same permitted real-player UUID allowed; unknown explosions protected; piston protection true; fluid/fire cross-claim protection false. World serverconfig and saved teams may override defaults.
BlockProtectionHelper converts real online player to native owner-profile FakePlayer for break/place events before mutation.
canModifyBlock checks level.mayInteract and optional FTBChunksHooks; the hook delegates EDIT_BLOCK to FTBChunks API with ServerPlayer.
Generic fireBreakEvent/firePlaceEvent allow null player; getPlayerFromUUID only resolves an online player. Strict helper variants deny missing owner, but not every caller uses a strict variant.

RitualPhantomBridge calls owner-UUID tryReplaceBlock and later refreshes/restores its native block entity; RitualHarvest delegates to harvest handlers and inserts through inventory capability. Full delayed/offline-owner/capability permission behavior was not functionally proven.
TelepositionSigilEffect inspected here teleports the player and binds an item; it is not evidence of a block-swap path.

safety.scope: Exact provenance/metadata and focused native bytecode. No all-mod ability pass, two-player claim matrix, dedicated/client acceptance or new protection guarantee.
